source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of creationism and spontaneous generation (PDF 215).

blocks.text: Creationism ke nazariye ke mutabiq, jise kitab 'theory of intelligent design' bhi kehti hai, sab jandar waise hi paida kiye gaye jaise aaj hain. Creationists ke nazdeek har qisam ka jandar alag alag paida kiya gaya aur tareekh mein badla nahi.

Qadeem log yeh bhi samajhte the ke jandar be-jaan maadde se ban sakte hain, yaani spontaneous generation ka khayal. Science ki taraqqi ke saath tajarbat ne spontaneous generation ko ghalat saabit kiya, lekin aise tajarbe creationism ki nafi nahi kar sake.

blocks.prompt: Tajarbat ne kis khayal ko ghalat saabit kiya: creationism ya spontaneous generation?
blocks.explanation: Spontaneous generation, yaani yeh khayal ke jandar be-jaan maadde se bante hain.

items: Creationism: jandar alag alag apni maujooda shakal mein paida kiye gaye.
Spontaneous generation: be-jaan maadde se zindagi; tajarbat se ghalat saabit.
